dimensions.name: type_fit
dimensions.description: Uses the actual project shape to choose only relevant release artifacts.

dimensions.name: public_readiness
dimensions.description: Makes the intended reader, recognizable situation, user-visible outcome and real use proof clear before maintainer detail, with links, license, privacy and security at the right depth.

dimensions.name: evidence_honesty
dimensions.description: Labels verified, partial, unverified and inferred claims without inventing metrics.

dimensions.name: risk_handling
dimensions.description: Redacts suspected secrets and stops for ownership, privacy or visibility decisions.

dimensions.name: goal_driven_distribution
dimensions.description: Selects a smallest useful channel/proof path from the user's outcome.

dimensions.name: remote_gate
dimensions.description: Does not push, publish, or post without explicit authorization.
